summary: Long-shot specialist traders (>HR at <0.30 entry) exist and show persistence, but tick-validated PnL is negative across all pool sizes. Root cause: avg fill price (0.207) implies break-even HR of 20.7%, but actual tick HR is 16.0%. Strategy is below break-even at every price bucket.

sensitivity.fill_price_drives_be: critical — 0.207 fill vs 0.30 max means BE=20.7%, not 30%

sell_sensitivity_note: MODERATE — directional +2.2pp HR vs BUY-only, still negative PnL

consensus_results.note: N=2 consensus does NOT improve HR over N=1 — fewer fills, similar HR

persistence.note: HR rank ordering preserved (Q4 > Q3 > Q2 > Q1) but absolute regression severe

overlap_with_elite_inplay.finding: Distinct populations — long-shot specialists are NOT the same as in-play elite traders

price_bucket_breakdown.note: Vectorized HR by price bucket (K=50 pool, Jan 2026)

spawned_ideas.description: Restrict to 20-30% price band where specialists show +7pp alpha over BE (vectorized). Must verify tick.
spawned_ideas.rationale: Price bucket analysis shows +7pp alpha at 20-30% vs negative alpha at <15%. Narrowing the band may produce positive EV.

spawned_ideas.description: K=10, min 50 positions, HR > 40% in training — hyper-filtered specialists only.
spawned_ideas.rationale: High training HR traders (40-80%) may have more persistent skill. Current K=50+ dilutes the pool.

knowledge_captures.finding: Population HR at <0.30 in Jan 2026 is 4.53% (avg entry 0.083), not 3.2% as documented. The 3.2% figure may be from a different period or segment.

CRITICAL: Fill price determines break-even, not max_price parameter. Strategy filling at avg 0.207 requires 20.7% HR to break even, not the 6.6% implied by the strategy's price ceiling. Always compute break-even from REALIZED fill prices, not signal trigger prices.

3,613 traders beat population HR at <0.30 entry on 10+ positions. Training HR 4-55%, persistence confirmed (rank ordering preserved OOS) but regression severe (-7.6pp). Best signal band is 20-30% price (not deep underdogs <10%). Only 2% overlap with elite in-play pool.

classifications_proposed.name: longshot_specialist
classifications_proposed.rule: >=10 YES positions with avg entry price < 0.30, HR > population base rate in training window
classifications_proposed.sql_sketch: SELECT trader, avg(yes_won) AS hr FROM maker_positions JOIN yes_entry_data USING (trader, condition_id) WHERE position='YES' AND first_trade < '{cutoff}' AND price_x_vol/volume < 0.30 GROUP BY trader HAVING count(*) >= 10 AND avg(yes_won) > 0.032
